# QR Code generator (C++)

`cpp/qrcodegen.hpp` and `cpp/qrcodegen.cpp` from Project Nayuki,
release v1.8.0, source commit `720f62bddb7226106071d4728c292cb1df519ceb`.

Upstream: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator

Only trailing whitespace has been normalized; the implementation is unchanged.

Copyright and the full MIT license are preserved at the top of both source files.
The plugin generates QR modules locally; it uses no external QR service.
